articles.summary: HONESDALE, Pa., March 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Norwood Financial Corp (NASDAQ Global Market - NWFL) and its subsidiary Wayne Bank, announced that the Board of Directors has declared a $0.32 per share cash dividend, which is payable on May 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of April 15, 2026.
articles.title: Norwood Financial Corp. Announces Cash Dividend
